paths.description: Entry/catalog template plus age-assurance gate; covers first impression, navigation, preferences, network, accessibility, security, and performance.
Search/listing archetype representing paginated thumbnail results and route discovery.
Representative video-detail and playback-readiness surface, including structured metadata and captions.
Account sign-in/sign-up archetype for authentication, consent, labels, and autofill.
Representative invalid route for failure messaging and recovery.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not declare or respond to the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Desktop light and emulated-dark screenshots are byte-identical (658,756-byte captures), computed colorScheme is normal, and no preference media rules were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() for a preference-driven palette.

findings.summary: A blocking age gate obscures every entry, listing, detail, and error page on load.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a large centered overlay covering primary content before interaction on all representative templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep age assurance proportionate, but reduce obstruction and preserve a clear, accessible route to the underlying task.

findings.summary: The blocking age gate is an ad-hoc div rather than a semantic modal dialog.
findings.evidence: Overlay probe found a DIV with no role, aria-modal, accessible label, inert background, or initial focus; the DOM contains zero dialog elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the gate as a modal <dialog>, label it, move focus into it, inert the background, and restore focus on close.

findings.summary: Route and state changes provide no transition continuity.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition usage; representative MPA navigation swaps instantly.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin listing-to-detail navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long listing chrome does not communicate scroll position or react to scroll state.
findings.evidence: Screenshots show long category/listing pages, while CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-state-aware header treatment or progress affordance where it helps orientation.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-wide only, with no component container adaptation.
findings.evidence: Platform probe found zero container rules across a card-heavy layout reused at different widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reusable thumbnail cards and controls rather than relying only on viewport breakpoints.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is slow.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 4.3 s, LCP 7.3 s, and performance 0.65, although the direct trace under a different run measured LCP 1.32 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, remove redirect latency, and shorten blocking dependency chains; verify under throttled repeat runs.

findings.summary: Render-blocking and cache inefficiencies delay content delivery.
findings.evidence: HAR identified a VeryHigh-priority parser stylesheet and three parser scripts without async/defer; Lighthouse estimated 2.63 s render-blocking savings and 5,039 KiB cache savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts, and apply durable immutable caching to versioned assets.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused and legacy code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 123 KiB unused CSS, 386 KiB unused JavaScript, and 52 KiB legacy JavaScript; HAR shows a 393 KiB xnxx.js plus jQuery and RequireJS.
findings.suggestedFix: Split by route and interaction, remove duplicate legacy dependencies, and load optional features conditionally.

findings.summary: Interactive controls and nearly all content images lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name and link-name; the image audit found 98 of 100 images without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give icon controls discernible names and thumbnail links meaningful accessible names; use empty alt only for truly decorative images.

findings.summary: The document has weak heading/dialog structure and the modal background remains exposed to assistive technology.
findings.evidence: Recon found no h1 on home, while the overlay has no dialog role, label, inert siblings, or initial focus. Visible focus itself was strong (3px yellow auto outline).
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1 per template and implement proper modal focus/inert semantics while retaining the visible focus style.

findings.summary: The viewport configuration restricts user scaling.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport because user-scalable=no or an equivalent maximum-scale restriction was observed in its audited response; narrow layouts otherwise had zero overflow and detail video exposed 23 subtitle tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and restrictive maximum-scale values, then retest zoom/reflow and target sizing.

findings.summary: Image markup is unsized and non-responsive.
findings.evidence: Image audit found all 100 images missing width/height and srcset, 12 oversized, and all in legacy JPG/PNG formats; Lighthouse also failed unsized-images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio and provide responsive srcset/sizes with modern formats.

findings.summary: Canonical signals are absent on inspected home/search surfaces.
findings.evidence: Home and search probes did not return a rel=canonical URL, although robots.txt and sitemap.xml were valid and indexing was allowed.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-referencing canonicals for indexable templates and keep sitemap URLs aligned.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS but important security headers are missing or weakened.
findings.evidence: Header probe found no HSTS or X-Content-Type-Options and a CSP allowing unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS and nosniff, remove unsafe-eval, and migrate inline code to nonces/hashes under a tighter CSP.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced privacy and permission policies are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers include X-Frame-Options but omit Permissions-Policy; Referrer-Policy is the permissive no-referrer-when-downgrade default.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and use strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer handling.

findings.summary: Account authentication is password-only and omits autofill semantics.
findings.evidence: Account probe found no WebAuthn/passkey surface; sign-in email/password fields had empty autocomplete values. No permission request code was detected on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete=username/current-password immediately and offer passkeys for phishing-resistant sign-in.

findings.summary: Sign-in and registration inputs omit autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: Account probe found empty autocomplete on email/login and password fields, while only reset-password fields used new-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Use email, username, current-password, new-password, and other appropriate tokens on every account form.

findings.summary: The thumbnail-heavy listing serves no responsive or modern image variants.
findings.evidence: All 100 audited images lacked srcset, all used JPG/PNG, 12 were oversized, and 89 below-fold images were not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants and srcset/sizes, set dimensions, and lazy-load below-fold thumbnails.

findings.summary: Initial page weight is high before the user chooses content.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse transferred 5,630 KiB in its cold run; HAR transferred 1.22 MiB in a separate run, including 536 KiB script and 453 KiB images before age-gate acceptance.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer below-fold thumbnails and non-essential media/scripts until after the gate or near viewport, with durable caching.
